sources.title: Run Sommerfugl-31B-v1 API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: Sommerfugl-31B: Enhanced Norwegian Language Model Sommerfugl-31B, developed by oolabs.no, is a 31 billion parameter language model built upon Google's gemma-4-31B-it. The primary goal of Sommerfugl-31B is to address and significantly improve the Norwegian language capabilities that were observed to regress in the instruction-tuned base Gemma model.
